title: Monthly Wholesale Trade: Sales and Inventories (October 2026 data) — 10:00 a.m. ET on FOMC decision day
source: EST: census.gov/economic-indicators/calendar-listview.html re-fetched direct 2026-09-06 (HTTP 200, 91,396 bytes) and parsed row-by-row across all 179 table rows by this session. The row reads exactly "Monthly Wholesale Trade: Sales and Inventories | December 9, 2026 | 10:00 AM | October 2026", release code A202612091000, reference A202610. Independently corroborated by the Atlanta Fed's GDPNowcastDataReleaseDates.xlsx (fetched direct 2026-09-06 at the live /-/media/Project/Atlanta/FRBA/Documents/... path), whose PostedUpdates sheet carries a 2026-12-09 row reading "Wholesale trade, Existing-home sales" — so unlike the 11-27 report this one does produce a publicly posted GDPNow vintage. Filed estimate per the event-research lane's no-self-confirm limit on an event discovered in-sweep, matching every sibling Census entry on this calendar.
notes: DISCOVERED during the advance-economic-indicators-2026-11-27 initial-research adjacency sweep (2026-09-06). Why it earns a row: that ledger's Leg 5 establishes that the Advance Economic Indicators Report's actual product is LEAD TIME on two data lines, and this calendar tracks the successor for only one of them. The goods-trade half of the 2026-11-27 print (October data) is closed 11 days later by intl-trade-full-report-2026-12-08, which is already an entry. The retail/wholesale INVENTORIES half is closed by this release, 12 days later — and it had no entry, a hole rather than a decision, the same shape of gap the thanksgiving-half-day-2026-11-27 sweep found when it discovered the 11-27 report itself. Impact is LOW and symbols is empty on the same measured grounds the sibling intl-trade-full-report entries record: no house playbook is macro-keyed (grep of trade-playbooks.md and multi-symbol-sweep.md returns 0 hits, run 2026-09-06), and there is no instrument attached. Two reading cautions belong with it rather than in a stance: it lands 10:00 a.m. ET on the second day of the December FOMC (federalreserve.gov panel 'December 8-9*'), four hours before the 14:00 statement, inside the communications blackout opened by fomc-blackout-start-2026-11-28 — so its own tape signature will be unreadable, exactly as advance-economic-indicators-2026-10-28 measured for the 10-28 print on decision-day morning (SPY 09:30-12:00 makes 44.8% of session range vs 80.1% baseline, n=21). And it sits three days INSIDE the cr-expiry-2026-12-11 funded window, so unlike advance-economic-indicators-2026-12-28 it is not funding-exposed. Proposed as an estimate; nothing here licenses an entry.
